bottom_line: The browser-agent QA wedge has a concrete public-flow demo path: at least one top prospect exposes a diagnosable signup/onboarding surface that can be converted into a safe outreach artifact.

diagnostics.demo_angle: Dogfood the browser-automation vendor's own signup surface for static fallback and first-step clarity.
findings: Heavy JavaScript surface (38 script tags) has no <noscript> fallback; browser diagnostics should capture first-paint/loading and console/network failures.
Static signup controls are visible without account creation; this is a good baseline target for copy, validation, and accessibility diagnostics.
